elements.label: Major Clarion
elements.description: Elizabeth 'Ann' Clarion. Heroine of Dunkirk, who led the last battalion to reduce that accursed cannon to scrap. Who stopped a retreat from becoming a massacre. It seems the Unfortunate One of the Island has reached out even here.
A calm and composed Allied officer who consistently comes to the aid of guerrilla forces—yet you've never heard a single word about her.

elements.label: Enemy Retreat!
elements.description: The enemy has been forced to withdraw from this area. Time to claim our reward.

elements.label: Contemplation: The Reformer
elements.description: The Mold-long, the Undying Wick, has ascended to the Mansus. His power has nurtured his own Immortal. They lead armies to expand their king's territory—but at least for now, we are all striving to liberate this land. Yet why has she appeared here? This place is clearly not part of their strategic plan.

elements.label: Contemplation: The Reformer's temper
elements.description: Elizabeth 'Ann' Clarion. Great hero of Dunkirk, who led the nearly shattered Allied forces and reduced that terrifying great cannon—which imprisoned one aspect of the Wolf-Divided—to scrap on the battlefield. She prevented a retreat from becoming a massacre. The New King has made this place her new proving ground, commanding her to continue her trial.

elements.label: Contemplation: The Reformer and the Iron Rose
elements.description: The shattered body of the great cannon illuminated the night sky over Calais. The newborn immortal and 'Iron Rose' met for the first time—spirits, war machines, armor, soldiers, and then themselves. In a duel where only one could survive, the destructive fire of Fetisova's cannon put an end to their battle. Their war has never ended. Only one of them is destined to live.
